integrity: The lower bound combines the published bipartite-class dichotomy with a new unique-midpoint obstruction for pairs drawn from different arms. The upper bound verifies one entire bipartition class and q explicitly described mixed sets. Equality in the lower-bound argument forces the complete minimum-set classification. A standalone checker directly evaluates the definition for q=3..6.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to balanced spiders with exactly three edges on every arm and at least three arms.
The path boundary q=2 has different minimum-set structure.
Unequal arm lengths, longer balanced spiders, and the general tree-extremality problem are not resolved.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= q <= 6 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed tree result could exist despite targeted literature and database searches.
title: Equidistant dimension and all bases of balanced three-edge spiders
